name: Whitney Plantation

location.text: Wallace, St. John the Baptist Parish, Louisiana

dates.note: The Wikipedia infobox says 1790 and 'Federal, French Creole'; the loc.gov catalogue entry for HABS LA-1194 prints '1810 Initial Construction'. Wikipedia's text dates the plantation's founding, as Habitation Haydel, to 1752. Recorded as the register has it, with the catalogue's date beside it.
